d: Ameriki midtarm chunav men abdul al-saiyad ki jit ne arab jagat se lekar israil tak naee bahas chher di hai. arab-ameriki aur muslim-ameriki pratinidhitv ke lihaz se unki jit ko aham mana ja raha hai. jahan samarthak ise ameriki rajniti men badalte samikarnon ka sanket bata rahe hain, vahin aalochak unke madhy purv par vicharon aur muslim bradarhud se kathit sanbandhon par saval utha rahe hain. israili midiya men bhi unki jit ko lekar tikhi pratikriyaen samne aaee hain. aakhir abdul al-saiyad ki jit ke mayne kya hain aur madhy purv men ise kis nazar se dekha ja raha hai?
